flow-definition.description: Builds businessplanner (Nextra) service images with docker buildx bake (docker-compose.yml + docker-bake.hcl) against base images pulled from Nexus, then pushes each app to Nexus. Light and frequent: run on app code changes. Never rebuilds base images. One bake target per inner stage, built+pushed+pruned in turn so peak disk is ~one image; a single failing target marks the build UNSTABLE instead of aborting the run.
